episodes.synopsis: To prevent further chaos, Pickle is sedated and brought to the Skytree lab. Musashi shocks everyone by slapping the prehistoric man in the face.
episodes.title: Pickle

episodes.synopsis: Tokugawa reunites Musashi with his legendary blade and meets with a resolute Motobe. Meanwhile, Pickle starves himself for the upcoming match.
episodes.title: Death Match

episodes.synopsis: The Sengoku era's strongest swordsman clashes with the Cretaceous' mightiest warrior — but what happens when Pickle himself takes up a sword?
episodes.title: The Beast and the Warrior

episodes.synopsis: At last, Motobe sees the culmination of his years of training. He throws every trick from the Sengoku period at Musashi to protect his comrades.
episodes.title: Protection

episodes.synopsis: After Musashi "slashes" the host on national TV, the Japanese police move to apprehend him. The samurai leaves the Tokugawa mansion and begins a rampage.
episodes.title: Cutting Off the Country

episodes.synopsis: The bloodbath continues as Musashi cuts through a platoon of the police's elite. Meanwhile, the President of the USA prepares for a meeting with Yujiro.
episodes.title: Un-Severable

episodes.synopsis: Musashi continues to resist, leaving a mountain of bodies in his wake. Later, Police Commissioner Utsumi asks one unlikely person to fight for the nation.
episodes.title: For the Country

episodes.synopsis: In Shinjuku, Hanayama stares into endless darkness and takes his signature stance. As he swings, Musashi seems blinded by his pure fighting spirit...
episodes.title: The Scar and the Sword

episodes.synopsis: Punching, pinning, crushing — Hanayama throws everything he has at Musashi. But can his iron muscles withstand every cut, slice and rip Musashi inflicts?
episodes.title: That Man, Hanayama

episodes.synopsis: Baki resolves to eradicate the samurai from this world and hones his body at a dojo. Meanwhile, Musashi prepares for the match with a visit to the sewers.
episodes.title: Eliminate

episodes.synopsis: The day of the showdown arrives. Before this once-in-a-lifetime match begins, an unimaginable sight unfolds before Musashi. Baki is ready to let loose.
episodes.title: Exquisite Skill

episodes.synopsis: Musashi retaliates brutally, proving that even barehanded, he is unmatched under heaven. But Baki will not back down until he buries the samurai.
episodes.title: The Way of the Sword
